title: Adaptive load stepping runtime
objective: Implement adaptive increment control based on Newton convergence behavior.
implementation_steps: Implement load stepping loop with configurable initial step size
Implement step cutback on Newton divergence/non-convergence
Implement step growth on fast convergence (e.g., < 4 iterations)
Implement minimum step size check and failure reporting
acceptance_criteria: Step growth triggers on fast convergence
Minimum step size failure reported clearly
Total load reached = 1.0 at end of successful analysis

cases: Repeated cutback: minimum step reached, failure reported
Full load reached after successful stepping

risks: Step size heuristics may need tuning for plasticity (Phase 8)
